album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 4

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F4 and dwells most on Bb in Rohab. The line peaks at C5 (505.2 Hz) at 0:49.0. It closes on G4, not the tonic (G4 → G4 → Bb4 → Bb4 → G4 → G4).
